strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Oh my, the enemy's come to greet us in person... How very hospitable.
Heh, we'll beat you guys into the ground with the Zambot 3!
Trying to slam a whole planet into Earth... What a crazy idea!
Enemies are still after La Mu's star, and others won't show themselves...
We can't get held up in a place like this...!
Heh... Hahahaha...
What's so funny!?
I don't like that guy.
This planet Dirad... Nothing can stop it now...
Dirad... So this planet is called Dirad...
Whatever you foolish Earthlings do, it is futile.
Banjo?
Shapiro Keats coming to greet us himself? I'm honored.
"Foolish Earthlings"... Wouldn't that describe you, the man who defected
to the Muge Zorbados Empire?
Heh... Are you trying to provoke me? Banjo Haran, was it?
I gave up on an Earth that only raises fools and casts them into space.
"Casts fools into space"...
If that's true, then that would make you one of them.
Not quite.
There was also a fool who tried to create a new humanity on Mars,
and only ended up giving Earth more enemies.
Big words. They're going to cost you.
This creep gets on my nerves every time he talks! Kappei! Let him have it!
Before I take you down, I want an answer! What are you after!?
Earth and this planet are both gonna get smashed!
Heh... I have no need to answer... You'll all die here anyway.
We'll see about that...!
For the world and its people, Daitarn 3 smashes the ambitions of evil!
If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun... come and get me!
...I needn't trouble myself with you... Do your best... Hahahaha.
What the heck!? Dang it!
Sitting back and watching from up there, like he's so cool!
If that's how he wants it, we'll just drag him out!
Gwaaaah!
Ilbora... This is the end...!
Damn... you... Uoooooh!
Huh? Where the heck did these guys come from?
...Those are from the Za Boom Army...!?
Damn it! You show up outta nowhere and then just run around!?
Ah! Joe, look!
Big Bro! It's Londo Bell!
Hm! If the Ninja Team's shown up, then...
So most of the heat sources are... here!
That's...!
The Gandor! You saved us!
Shazara!
Princess...! I'm so glad you're safe!
We don't go down that easily.
Let's go out, Roll.
All right, time to cut loose!
Zambot 3... It's been a while.
Heh, Kyosuke, Big Bro, you're as unfriendly as ever.
Mind your own business.
Where's Raideen!?
Akira!
Enjoy your space trip? Akira!
Guys! ...I've been busy. The fun part's still ahead, Mister.
Master Banjo, how are things proceeding?
Just as you see, Garrison.
We're aware of the operation! Sorry we're late.
No, we've held on with a small elite team. ...Still, we're grateful.
Where are the others!?
What happened to the group that went into the planet's core!?
With the Nadesico's capabilities, the worst case seems unlikely, but...
The Mazinger team and Duke's group are with them, so they're okay!?
We... only saw Umon and the others pushing deeper inside.
Can't you get through to the Nadesico ladies either!?
Sadly, no... I hoped the magnetic field would weaken a little once inside.
Anyway, if they headed for the core, things are going to plan for now!
...Heh... Fools. Half-baked optimism is meaningless.
Sara...
Looks like he's real pleased with himself, leading all those Muge mechs.
He's just king of a very small hill.
...That bastard. I'm gonna settle this, Shapiroooo!
There's no time! ...If you stand in our way, I'll show no mercy!
If we don't stop this planet... it'll all be over.
Shapiro! What's the meaning of this,
using those Muge creeps' mechs lately!?
Don't tell me Muge made that fake Dancougar outside too!?
Heh... Heheheheh...
No, more importantly... how'd you come back from hell!? Say something!
Sara... Why do you fight for the sake of Earth?
...Back when I predicted the coming of the aliens,
surely you remember what those Federation fools said.
...That's no answer!
Shapiro Keats... No, let me call you Major Keats.
...Your recommendation back then did reach the Federation's top brass.
However... the Federation government took the wrong path.
Meaning... the Titans.
The Titans were meant to counter offworld threats like Zeon remnants,
such as the Zeon remnants, but they lost their way...
Captain Bright and... Kamille would know better how that ended.
Heh, that no longer has anything to do with me.
Shapiro, you...
It seems he never meant to talk to us as equals...
Equals? ...Heheheh...
No one in this universe can speak with me as an equal!
Such arrogance...!
Sara... I am now moving to take this universe into my hands once more...
Come back to me.
It's over, Shapiro. Between me... and you.
And your ambitions too...
Sara...
Dunno what happened, but this seems like a messy breakup.
But... we have to smash the enemy and push through...!
That's right... Shapiro, we're coming through!
In the end, Sara... you're just another foolish Earthling.
Hmm...? Heheh... Bark all you like while you still can.
You bastard! You think you can get away!? Shapiroooo!
There's no way he can get away like this!
Heheheh... Sara, you are my enemy now. Don't forget it...!
I've thought so... ever since this fight began... Shapiro...!
Reinforcements!?
That's...!
Long time no see, Joe!
You... Ilboraaa!
Showing up at a time like this! Nobody asked for you!
No, Hyoma! He was waiting for the right moment!
What a dirty coward!
I've had a bad feeling ever since I saw those Za Boom Army mechs.
Showing up at the worst possible time!
Your timing sucks as much as ever, Ilbora!
When it comes to beating you, time and place don't matter!
All I care about is defeating you!
Nobody likes a guy who won't let go!
...No, Allenby, this is... obsession. The obsession of the one giving chase.
Ilbora! The reason Princess Romina relied on Joe... the reason...
was that we were the only ones who could operate the three machines!
That's no reason to join the Za Boom Army just to get in Big Bro's way!
Silence! ...There's no turning back for me now. Joe, face me!
...If you've the strength to choose to keep fighting, you can turn back too.
Making someone see what's right... is never an easy thing, but...
Why does there have to be a fight like this...!
The enemy won't wait for us!
In that sense, maybe the Campbellians and their kind are simpler.
Maybe war is nothing more than a pile of things like this...
...I'll settle this... Ilbora!
Ilbora! Knock it off already!
Joe...! You're the one who brought me this low!
I won't be lectured by the likes of you!
Don't blame others for your own selfishness, Ilbora!
...Even if you beat us here...
that doesn't mean you can go back to Princess Romina!
Ngh, wh-what are you... Joe!
...You're nothing but an enemy now!
Rushing out to fight isn't the only way to protect someone!
After you left, what the Princess felt while she kept fighting...
Do you even understand that!?
And then you defect to the enemy! What're you even after, Ilbora!?
...Silence... Silence! Joe!
Joe...! You're the one who brought me this low!
I won't be lectured by the likes of you!
Don't blame others for your own selfishness, Ilbora!
...Even if you beat us here...
that doesn't mean you can go back to Princess Romina!
Ngh, wh-what are you... Joe!
...You're nothing but an enemy now!
Rushing out to fight isn't the only way to protect someone!
After you left, what the Princess felt while she kept fighting...
Do you even understand that!?
And then you defect to the enemy! What're you even after, Ilbora!?
...Silence... Silence! Joe!
It's over, Big Bro.
...Ilbora... You idiot...
...Huh...!? Joe, Mike! Something... something's coming!
...Ugh... Ngh...
What!? That unit's not in the Za Boom Army data!
...Similar...? Doesn't that machine look similar!?
Tobikage!? The one that always comes to help...
Uoooooooh!
A black... Tobikage!? No, wait! Ilbora, is that you!?
Hm? Careful! There's more coming!
Just as His Majesty the Emperor said, Zerokage chose Ilbora...
Good, let's finish them in one push! Follow me!
Yes, sir!
They just keep coming, one after another!
Tobikage!?
What the!? Now a white one's showing up!?
Commander Hazuki, what is that!?
Still... it does look like that new black model.
They're probably connected.
Who cares!? If it's an enemy, we just smash it!
Simple, but yeah, that's how it goes.
...Hm...? Tobikage is... calling me...?
He ran!? Get back here! Ilbora!
Maya, don't pursue too far! It may be a trap!
Like I care! I've gotta settle things with him!
No, Joe! Everyone's fighting here, you know!?
If you charge off on your own, you're no different from Ilbora!
She's right, Big Bro!
Ngh... Ilbora... What happened to you...!
What the hell is that black machine...?
Tch! I've lost Zerokage in this strong magnetic field...!?
What'll you do now? At this point, we'll take you all together...!
The fake Tobikage's gone too. Maybe you should run along with it?
What...!? Don't mock me!
D-damn it! I can't be defeated in a place like this!
Oh, come on! He got away.
Good work, everyone.
But there's no time to rest... Return to the Gandor at once.
We have to head for the next point.
Can't be helped, but... this is a forced march.
That's not all... It seems this fight won't end just by beating the enemy.
What do you mean, Ryo?
...Shapiro Keats is alive...
...and he's tied to Muge Zorbados, who was also supposedly beaten?
Exactly. But it seems they know more about it than us ground troops.
You mean Fujiwara and the others.
The Cyber Beast Force... the ones who destroyed the Muge Empire.
...We don't really get it either. Damn it...!
You mean that Shapiro guy?
No, the problem is the robots Shapiro had with him...
What do you mean?
Come to think of it, some of those we didn't see when we fought in space.
It's been bugging me.
...We keep seeing mechs of the Muge Zorbados Empire we beat last war...
I figured they were just survivors, but...
There were new models too. No way...
We can't afford to waste time worrying. Let's hurry on for now.
Right! We have to go after the Nadesico team!
With all our communications cut off like this, it's unsettling.
Are we still all right on time?
Dirad's approach is within projections, but... the dragon...
...Commander, it seems we'd better hurry.
? What are you talking about, Captain?
Nothing... Hurry and get aboard. We're heading deeper in.
